display_long_description:
Dive into the vibrant atmosphere of São Paulo with Batuque Beats VR, a virtual reality rhythm game that brings the magic of Carnival to Meta Quest. Embark on a journey as a new bateria conductor, mastering the art of percussion, from the rehearsal court to the parade at the sambódromo.

Prepare for an immersive and culturally rich experience. In Batuque Beats VR, every beat is a note, and your precision is the key to success. The game offers intuitive mechanics and a learning curve designed for everyone, from beginners to rhythm masters. With controls adapted for VR, you'll use your hands as virtual drumsticks, hitting notes that move along an original soundtrack.

The game celebrates Brazilian musical tradition, with settings inspired by authentic locations in São Paulo and a soundtrack that celebrates samba. The journey is a progression of difficulty, where you'll start with a simple rehearsal in the community court and evolve to the peak of the Carnival parade.

Batuque Beats VR was designed with accessibility in mind, offering a full settings menu that allows you to customize your experience, including colorblind adjustments, visual options, and difficulty.
